capabilities.notes: Installed Skill launches an ephemeral leg-A container from the active researcher image by exact image ID. Read-only rootfs, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, network none; only the episode/portfolio state mount is writable. Source registration plus live image shadow labels must both pass before AVAILABLE. Flat freeze and portfolio-freeze public verbs always fail closed (FLAT_FREEZE_NOT_PRODUCTION / PORTFOLIO_FREEZE_CLI_NOT_PRODUCTION); sole production freeze is portfolio-only xinao prospective freeze-from-disposition. Caller-outcome shadow settle verbs reject disposition-bound freezes and remain only for sealed historical/fixture objects; the committing production consumer independently reparses source raw CAS. Account P&L never promotes scientific grade.
Skill/CLI shadow freeze verb is fail-closed (FLAT_FREEZE_NOT_PRODUCTION). Production Owner freeze: packaged xinao prospective freeze-from-disposition only.
Caller-outcome settle is historical/fixture only. Production Portfolio settlement reparses sealed source raw CAS through xinao prospective portfolio-settle-all-from-reveal.

Multi-turn ResearchEpisode plus public one-shot result+receipt pool admission. Public host vertical: start -> ensure-pair -> prepare-actor-materials -> attach-run|resume-live --actor-material-root -> checkpoint/cancel -> export-candidate-evidence (candidate-only). The actor-material root consumes the exact period-appropriate 4/7-file set and binds the canonical candidate-manifest authoring syntax without supplying ACTION/NO_ACTION, number, stake, rationale, method, or stopping behavior; it cannot mix with generic --material. An explicit start may bind a settled feedback pack and independent Portfolio-state CAS; attach/resume revalidates and places it in the provider prompt but never claims model learning or auto-starts a successor. ensure-pair materializes disposable dual containers under a CAS head; retire-pair/cancel never schedule a successor. Host modules sealed under skill-bundle scripts/host_modules; transport uses sealed internal network; auth via XINAO_AUTH_HOST_PATH|GROK_HOME|~/.grok. Preferred Owner pool/feedback consumers are packaged xinao-discovery console verbs requiring installed package, not monorepo parents walk. ensure-pair/attach-run/resume-live require sealed dual images + tool-namespace receipt. Productive evidence is success-only (status=ok). absorb is deprecated local outbox and NOT pool admission. Codex alone adopts/disposes/freezes. Never auto-adopt/auto-freeze/auto-settle/auto-next/leg-B.
